podcast.title: Grammy Nominee (1980)
podcast.body: The Blues Brothers were nominated for the Grammy for Best New Artist in 1980 but lost to Ricky Lee Jones. "She was up against the Blues Brothers, the NAC, Robin Williams and Dire Straits."

podcast.title: Dan Aykroyd Wines
podcast.body: Dan Aykroyd, known for his role in The Blues Brothers, has his own wine label, Dan Aykroyd Wines, based in Ontario. "He has Dan Acroid wines in Ontario."
